### virtual time algorithm  {.smaller}


* track: 
   * virtual finish time of last packet for each flow
   * "current" virtual time
* on receive packet:
   * compute virtual start time of packet =  max of 
      * virtual finish time from last packet in same flow
      * "current" virtual time
   * compute virtual finish time of packet =  
      * virtual start time + packet size
* when sending, send with lowest virtual finish time

### virtual time scaling {.smaller}

* suppose we can send 1 bit/wallclock time unit
* 0 active flow: 0 units virtual time (no matter wallclock time)
* 1 active flow: 1 unit virtual time per 1 unit wallclock time
* 2 active flow: 1 unit virtual time per 2 unit wallclock time
* ...
<hr class="vspace"/>
* can track correct virtual time by updating:
  * when queue becomes empty, or
  * packet arrives
* new virtual time = old virtual time + elapsed wallclock time $\div$ active queues
